# Documentation path-specific instructions

- Keep documentation synchronized with actual behavior, commands, file paths, and workflow names in the repository.
- Prefer concise, task-oriented guidance with runnable examples that match current tooling.
- When code behavior changes, update only directly related documentation sections.
- Avoid speculative or unverifiable statements; document known limitations explicitly.
- Maintain consistency with existing terminology across backend, frontend, infra, and agent architecture docs.
